dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: Welcome to Fontaine! Please, do watch your step.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Court of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: You may ride the lift at the side to the Court, and there you shall see the Palais Mermonia, the beating heart of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: If you've ridden one of our aquabuses, I'm sure you've heard a Melusine tour guide introduce Fontaine, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: Well, now you'll get to experience it for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Melusine tour guides...

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: As far as I know, Melusines are our special companions.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: But don't underestimate them on account of their appearance. The ones amongst them in uniform are detectives from the Marechaussee Phantom.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: ...That includes the guides.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: Just like us humans, different Melusines have their unique personalities.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: The sort of introduction you'll get will thus depend on the Melusine serving as your guide.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: See you! May you have a wonderful day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the aquabus lines...

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: There are three aquabus lines here in Fontaine — the Callas Line, the Clementine Line, and the Navia Line.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: These three names were not chosen at random, far from it. They refer to Callas, the President of the Spina di Rosula, his wife, and his daughter respectively.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: The aquabus had a truly troubled gestation — if not for the Spina, we'd still be navigating on foot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the lift...

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: It stops at 4 different levels. Level 1 is the main aquabus station hall, and the highest one leads straight to the Palais Mermonia.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: We are presently at Level 2. Before us is the Clementine Line, which links Romaritime Harbor with the main station. The third level, for its part, is the Navia Line, which leads to Erinnyes.

dialogues.speaker: Grosley
dialogues.text: A lot of travelers get the floors mixed up, so be careful now.
